article.title: Toledo hosts Bowling Green in MAC play
article.linkText: Toledo hosts Bowling Green in MAC play
article.story: Bowling Green (3-7) at Toledo (8-2), Nov. 20 at 7:30 p.m. EST. Opening Line: Toledo by 15.5. Against the spread: Toledo 5-4-1, Bowling Green 5-5. How to watch: ESPN2 Key stats Toledo Offense Overall: 453.4 yards per game (17th in FBS) Passing: 256.2 yards per game (30th) Rushing: 197.2 yards per game (24th) Scoring: 34.3 points per game (23rd) Toledo Defense Overall: 301.7 yards per game (21st in FBS) Passing: 192 yards per game (39th) Rushing: 109.7 yards per game (25th) Scoring: 22 points per game (46th) Bowling Green Offense Overall: 292.5 yards per game (135th in FBS) Passing: 181.6 yards per game (116th) Rushing: 110.9 yards per game (124th) Scoring: 19.3 points per game (125th) Bowling Green Defense Overall: 383.6 yards per game (91st in FBS) Passing: 185.1 yards per game (25th) Rushing: 198.5 yards per game (127th) Scoring: 28.9 points per game (106th) Toledo ranks 25th in FBS in defensive third down percentage, allowing opponents to convert on 32.7% of third downs. Toledo ranks 124th in the FBS averaging 71.7 penalty yards per game, compared to Bowling Green's 49th-ranked 49.5 per-game average. Toledo ranks 113th in FBS in red zone defense, allowing opponents to score on 89.3% of trips. Bowling Green's red zone offense ranks 115th, scoring in 79.2% of red zone trips. Team leaders Toledo Passing: John Alan Richter, 2,501 yards, 19 TDs, 3 INTs, 65.4 completion percentage Rushing: C.J. Miller, 827 yards on 151 carries, 7 TDs Receiving: Adjatay Dabbs, 736 yards on 47 catches, 7 TDs Bowling Green Passing: Jay Kastantin, 1,567 yards, 11 TDs, 8 INTs, 66.7 completion percentage Rushing: Austyn Dendy, 371 yards on 104 carries, 4 TDs Receiving: Jeremiah Scoby, 341 yards on 33 catches, 0 TDs Last game Toledo defeated UMass 24-0 on Nov. 11. Richter led Toledo with 197 yards on 13-of-22 passing (59.1%) for one touchdown and no interceptions. Connor Walendzak carried the ball 14 times for 117 yards and scored one touchdown, adding three receptions for 41 yards and one touchdown. Dabbs put up 144 yards on seven catches. Bowling Green won 33-28 over Kent State on Nov. 10. Austin Novosad led Bowling Green with 229 yards on 15-of-25 passing (60.0%) for three touchdowns and no interceptions. Nakai Amachree had 110 rushing yards on 19 carries and one touchdown, adding three receptions for 87 yards and one touchdown. Eli Jacon-Duffy had three receptions for 59 yards and one touchdown. Next game Toledo plays at Ohio on Nov. 27. Bowling Green hosts UMass on Nov. 28.
